note: The public plugin index (https://marshallku.github.io/aide-plugins/plugins.json), as scripts/sync-from-aide.mjs last read it.

plugins.name: Eisenhower matrix
plugins.description: Open todos sorted into do / schedule / delegate / drop by priority and due date.
plugins.author: AIDE

plugins.name: Excalidraw
plugins.description: Draw in your notes. New drawing from a note's plugin menu; Edit on a drawing opens it again. A drawing is an SVG that keeps its scene (drawings/*.excalidraw.svg), so every note reader shows it, with this plugin or without.
plugins.author: AIDE

plugins.name: Kanban
plugins.description: Boards of cards in lanes, written in notes under boards/ the way Obsidian's Kanban plugin writes them (## lanes, - [ ] cards), so a board opens in both. Drag cards between lanes, add, tick off and remove them.
plugins.author: AIDE

plugins.name: Pomodoro
plugins.description: Focus timer drawn with native controls (25/5 by default); counts finished sessions per day, and at 21:00 adds the day's count to the note pomodoro/log.
plugins.author: AIDE

plugins.name: Recall
plugins.description: Spaced repetition over cards you write in notes (`front :: back`, `front ::: back` both ways, or a question, a line with ?, and its answer), and over cards the server plugin makes every night from what you newly wrote, which wait in an inbox until you accept them. Schedules each card on the forgetting curve (FSRS) and keeps your reviews in recall/log, so every device and the server's daily reminder agree.
plugins.author: AIDE

plugins.name: Word count
plugins.description: Counts the words of the note you're reading: in the desktop's right panel as you go, or from the editor's plugin menu.
plugins.author: AIDE
